_about: Hall layouts, read once per hall from the seat map the cinema shows during booking (a person went as far as the seat page; no seat was picked): elCinema's for Premiere halls, VOX's own (egy.voxcinemas.com, as a guest) for VOX halls, Scene's own (<venue>.scenecinemas.com; its plan is drawn turned 180°, recorded as shown) for Scene halls, Renaissance's own booking page data (rnscinemas.com/en/start_booking/<id>, matched by screen id) for Renaissance halls; for elCinema-sold cinemas also elCinema's hall lookup (booking/ajax_dropdowns, type screens), which returns each hall's seat plan without any booking. Rows run from the screen backwards (VOX letters its rows from the back, so its A is last). Each row lists its cells left to right as you face the screen: a seat number, or '.' for a gap or aisle; a row of only '.' is a gap between rows. A hall with no formats is recorded but not matched to shows; formats match a show's format part by part, whole words (see Halls.forShowtime). Prices are what the hall showed when recorded.
